description: Full-text search of digitized historical U.S. newspapers (~1690s–present) from the Library of Congress "Chronicling America" collection. Find primary-source newspaper coverage of any person, event, place, or topic in history — returns the newspaper, publication date, city/state, a link to the digitized page, and the page-scan image URL. Filter by date range and U.S. state. Example: search_newspapers({ query: "influenza epidemic", date_from: "1918", date_to: "1919", state: "oklahoma" }).

date_from.description: Earliest year or date (e.g. "1918" or "1918-01-01"). Defaults to the collection start.

date_to.description: Latest year or date (e.g. "1919"). Defaults to present.

query.description: Full-text search terms (matched against the OCR'd newspaper text).

state.description: U.S. state name to restrict to (lowercase, e.g. "california", "new york").

name: search_newspapers
title: Search Newspapers
